h: In the Home of the British Army
p: Wellington Street sits right at the heart of Aldershot's shopping area, by the Wellington Centre, so this MERKUR is easy to find if you're in for the shops. The station is a short walk away, with trains to London Waterloo. It's 18+ only.

Aldershot is known as the Home of the British Army, and the Aldershot Military Museum is worth a look to see how the garrison town grew up. Aldershot Town play at the Recreation Ground just outside the centre, and Princes Hall puts on comedy, pantos and tribute acts throughout the year if you want a night out.
